digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate, operator-attested evidence contract, measurement provenance validation
propositions: [operator-attested] evidence contract requires measurement provenance (environment, principal, privilege_posture, instrument) to be explicitly declared in a structured continuation-line format under each checkbox item, with placeholder values rejected deterministically

Wrong-environment escape: measurements taken in account 579718921998/us-east-2 were attested as valid for work targeting account 896586841071/us-east-1, undetectable without provenance fields linking to repo-anchor IaC backend names

Privilege-masking escape: live bedrock:Converse calls under bedrock:* identity offered as validation for scoped bedrock:InvokeModel grant, structurally unable to fail, later disproven by simulate-principal-policy in production context

Deterministic presence-and-shape check (det_measurement_provenance.py) validates all four provenance fields exist, are non-placeholder, and enum fields (privilege_posture, instrument) match allowed literals; makes no semantic judgment of correctness

AGENT-tier criterion project.measurement-provenance reads repo anchors (IaC backend account identifiers) and compares to declared environment, flags privilege_posture:broader on scoped-permission criteria, and catches instrument:simulation/static-analysis on authorization claims as non-refutable by simulation alone
Existing [operator-attested] criteria without provenance fields are grandfathered advisory-only, never blocking, preserving backward compatibility for tickets predating this contract change
